title: Retry Tollbooth Pay calls five times
author: kasia.brandt
body:
## Proposal

Raises how many times a failed Tollbooth Pay capture gets retried before we give up on it, aimed at riding out longer brownouts like the one in GW-167. Not merged -- see discussion below.

comments.author: lev.anand
comments.body: Does Tollbooth Pay mind us hammering it with more retries on a single capture?

comments.author: mara.voss
comments.body: Checked with their integration docs, and this would backfire: 3 is already the ceiling, not 5, because Tollbooth Pay starts rate-limiting a merchant once it sees more than 3 retries on one failed capture inside a minute. Going to 5 would get us throttled during exactly the brownouts we're trying to ride out. Closing this.
